answer_1.quote: We present ECTSum, the first long document summarization dataset in the finance domain that requires models to process long unstructured earning call transcripts and summarize them in a few words while capturing crucial metrics and maintaining factual consistency.
answer_1.outputs: bullet-point summaries of earnings call transcripts

answer_2.quote: We benchmark the performance of several representative summarization approaches ... on our newly proposed dataset. ... competing methods are evaluated on several metrics that assess the content quality and factual consistency of the model-generated summaries.

answer_4.quote: Given the complex nuances of the financial domain, we get the model-generated summaries evaluated by a team 10 analysts/experts working with Goldman Sachs Data Science and Machine Learning Group, India who were well-versed with the concepts of financial reporting, earnings calls, etc.
answer_4.guideline: participants were required to go through an entire ECT ... and evaluate the two summaries ... on three quality metrics - factual correctness, relevance and coverage
